findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /alerts/subscribe has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: Public by design (no user accounts). Double opt-in: stores nothing until the emailed token is redeemed; 5/min rate limit, per-address cooldown, gated by ALERTS_ENABLED.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /alerts/confirm has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: Authorised by the emailed confirmation token (hashed, single-use, regex-validated) rather than a session. 10/min rate limit.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /alerts/unsubscribe has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: Authorised by the subscriber's emailed unsubscribe token; same response whether or not it matches, so no oracle. 10/min rate limit.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /alerts/unsubscribe/one-click has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe target; must accept unauthenticated POSTs from mail providers. Token-gated, 30/min rate limit.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /analytics/event has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: First-party analytics beacon, not a webhook. Anonymous by design; 120/min rate limit, event name truncated, props sanitised and size-capped, always 204.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /portfolio/share has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: Anonymous share links by design. Positions validated (tracked codes, finite bounded amounts, max 50), 10/min rate limit, share URL built from server-side APP_URL.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.message: POST /roi has no auth middleware, decorator, or session check that Lens could see. Confirm it is guarded upstream (gateway, global middleware) or intended to be public.
findings.triageNote: Stateless calculation: POST only carries the request body; nothing is written. Inputs validated and bounded, 30/min rate limit.

Admin and role checks on the server

checklist.title: Paid AI APIs behind spend caps
evidence: uses anthropic: set a monthly cap in that provider's billing settings

checklist.title: Prices set server-side; access granted only from a verified Stripe webhook
Real auth provider, no homemade password or session handling
Short-lived access tokens; refresh tokens revoked on logout
Rate limits on auth, email sends, and AI endpoints
Schema validation on every route, unknown fields rejected
evidence: Unknown fields are accepted silently (no .strict() / extra='forbid').

checklist.title: SSRF: user-supplied URLs can't reach private or metadata IPs

checklist.title: Model input untrusted; agent tools constrained

checklist.title: Production credentials not reachable by agents or dev tooling
evidence: Keep prod keys out of local .env files and agent-accessible shells.

checklist.title: Storage private; files via signed URLs; uploads not served from the app origin
evidence: No file storage or upload libraries detected.

checklist.title: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML / unsanitized HTML on user or model output

checklist.title: No public source maps, debug routes, Swagger or GraphQL introspection in prod

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL persistence via asyncpg connection pool. All public functions are async. The pool is created in init_db() (called at startup) and stored as the module-level _pool, accessed via get_pool(). Timestamps are stored as ISO 8601 strings (UTC) in TEXT columns so they sort lexicographically — identical semantics to the prior SQLite schema.

PROVIDER CHAIN ------------ Each commodity declares an ordered list of providers, tried until one returns usable data. No single upstream can disable the factor: yahoo Free, no key, daily. nodes.name: normalise_to_window
nodes.summary: Convert a price series into a TARGET_WINDOW_DAYS-equivalent % change. Picks the observation closest to TARGET_WINDOW_DAYS before the newest one, measures the real calendar span between them, and scales geometrically: (last / first) ** (TARGET_WINDOW_DAYS / span_days) - 1 This is what lets a monthly series be compared with a daily one. Returns None if the series cannot support a meaningful change.

nodes.summary: Exotic Rates Service — scrapes real-world parallel/black market rates for currencies where commercial FX APIs return fictional official rates. Each scraper: - Uses httpx async GET/POST with a realistic User-Agent - Parses response (HTML or JSON) - Returns (rate_float, source_name, data_confidence) or None on failure - Caches results for 6 hours (these rates don't move by the minute) - Falls back s

nodes.name: _fetch_irr
nodes.summary: bonbast.com is the most-cited black market rate tracker for IRR. Strategy: the page embeds a one-time token in a JS block which is used to POST to /json — returns a JSON dict with 'usd1' (buy) and 'usd2' (sell). We use usd2 (sell = what IRR holders get when converting to USD). Rate is IRR per 1 USD — we invert to get USD per 1 IRR.

nodes.name: _fetch_ves
nodes.summary: DolarToday is the definitive parallel market rate tracker for VES. Public JSON endpoint — no scraping needed. Rate is VES per 1 USD — we invert.

nodes.name: _fetch_lbp
nodes.summary: lirarate.org tracks the Sayrafa-adjacent street rate for LBP. Rate is LBP per 1 USD — we invert.

nodes.name: _fetch_zwl
nodes.summary: Zimbabwe replaced ZWL with ZiG (ZWG) in April 2024. RBZ.co.zw is protected by a Radware captcha — direct scraping is blocked. ExchangeRate-API reliably covers ZWG (and aliases it as ZWL), making it the best available source for this currency. Requires FX_API_KEY (ExchangeRate-API v6) in environment. Rate is ZWG per 1 USD — we invert to USD per 1 ZWG.

nodes.name: _fetch_mmk
nodes.summary: CBM publishes a public JSON API with official rates. Note: the official rate (~2,100) diverges significantly from the parallel market rate (~4,200+). We return the official rate and flag accordingly. Rate: MMK per 1 USD → we invert.

nodes.name: test_alpha_vantage_calls_are_paced_across_commodities
